```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Medium severity alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When a medium severity alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm should be indicated with a yellow color
    And the alarm should have a flashing frequency of 0.5Hz with a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: High severity alarm with 10 pulses
    Given the system is initialized
    When a high severity alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm should have an auditory signal consisting of 10 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms
    And the pulse frequency should be 500Hz

  Scenario: High severity alarm with 4 pulses
    Given the system is initialized
    When a high severity alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm should have an auditory signal consisting of 4 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms
    And the pulse frequency should be 500Hz

  Scenario: Audio pause key press
    Given the system is initialized and alarms are active
    When the AUDIO PAUSE / ALARM PAUSE key is pressed
    Then all active alarms should be paused for 60 seconds
    And the alarm activation symbol should be displayed with the symbol IEC 60417-5576

  Scenario: Apnea alarm
    Given the system is initialized and apnea time interval is exceeded
    When no breath is triggered
    Then a medium priority alarm should be triggered with the display text "APNEA ALARM"

  Scenario: High breath rate alarm
    Given the system is initialized and breath rate exceeds the setting
    When the breath rate is exceeded
    Then a medium level alarm should be triggered with the display text "HIGH BREATH RATE"

  Scenario: Low pressure alarm
    Given the system is initialized and pressure is low
    When a low pressure alarm is triggered
    Then a high severity alarm should be triggered with the display text "LOW INSP P"

  Scenario Outline: Maximum breath rate setting
    Given the system is initialized
    When the breath rate is set to <breath_rate>
    Then the maximum breath rate setting should be <max_breath_rate>
    And the alarm threshold should be <max_breath_rate>

    Examples:
      | breath_rate | max_breath_rate |
      |-------------|-----------------|
      | 12          | 12              |
      | 15          | 15              |
      | 20          | 20              |
      | 25          | 25              |
      | 30          | 30              |
```
